name: Thumbnail Store
description: ThumbnailStore, the disk preview store: opaque encoded preview bytes keyed by PreviewKey (asset, content token, SizeClass), PreviewEntry with its VolumeRef and relative path, and Availability (online or offline). The store writes, reads and removes previews in its folder (PreviewFiles: index.json plus digest-named p/<2 hex>/<16 hex>.bin files, each a versioned header naming its key, volume and path ahead of the payload, replaced by temp file and rename under an exclusive flock) and holds them to a byte budget by least-recently-used eviction. Reads flush the index at most every 2 s and on close, merged with the index on disk. PreviewIndex is the index codec and its recovery: an index that is damaged or of a newer version is set aside as index.damaged.json and rebuilt from the files' headers, orphan temp files and entries whose file is gone are cleared at open. OfflineVolumes lists one volume's entries by volume id and reports an entry offline when its volume id is not among the mounted ones, while its bytes still read; an entry with no volume is always online.
